description.en: The name of the MPS queue.

description.zh: 优先级，1-10，默认6。数值越大，优先级越高。
description.en: The priority. Default value: 6. Valid values: 1 to 10. A greater value specifies a higher priority.

description.zh:
管道类型。取值：

- Standard：标准管道

- Boost：倍速转码管道

- NarrowBandHDV2：窄带高清2.0管道
description.en:
The type of the MPS queue. Valid values:

1. Standard: standard MPS queue.

2. Boost: MPS queue with transcoding speed boosted.

3. NarrowBandHDV2: MPS queue that supports Narrowband HD 2.0.
